vb_textbox.text: there are 2 pairs of gnomes: red/pink & brown/greenStart of by picking whatever colour you want, if you get 3 or less mushrooms then select the alternate colour gnome & you should get a lot more pointse.g. Red & brown gnomes are your choicesIf you pick red gnome & get 6 mushrooms then pick the pink gnome & keep alternating between these 2 colours until you start getting barely any mushrooms. Once this happens, start picking the brown/green gnomes & repeat until you're done. I got about 1020ish points from this method.Also, when you need to press space to collect mushrooms, spam the space bar as i found the game to not register my presses if i just did it the once.Good luck :)
